name: Buffoon Runners Remastered
summary: Buffoon Runners Remastered is a Gorilla Tag fangame that is located mainly in the Backrooms, Level 0. Try to survive for however long you can, but if you don't want to survive, you could check out the shop, with multiple cosmetics to lighten up your look, with more to come in the future. More maps, monsters, gamemodes, and features will be added in the future!
